run_generate_simplify_text: run generate.py with stdin input to simplify complex text using a Fairseq model
run_prepare_models: run prepare_models to download and set up the best simplification model directory
run_get_preprocessors: run get_preprocessors with kwargs to create a list of text preprocessing strategies
run_get_fairseq_simplifier: run get_fairseq_simplifier with a model directory and beam size to load a simplifier
run_get_preprocessed_simplifier: run get_preprocessed_simplifier to wrap a simplifier with preprocessing steps
